tasks.title: Enforce strict repository consistency and provenance contracts
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one canonical package manager and lockfile
Package, lockfile, release, changelog, CI and repository identity agree
Tracked dist is reproducible from source on clean CI checkout
Unknown contract drift fails closed

tasks.title: Make asset freshness classification strict and fail-closed
acceptance_criteria: Bookkeeping-only upstream metadata cannot block asset freshness
Runtime asset or manifest drift blocks until explicit UI sync
Unknown upstream files block by default
Classification is covered by executable regression tests

tasks.title: Eliminate package-manager and release metadata inconsistencies
acceptance_criteria: npm is the sole package manager
package-lock.json is the sole lockfile
No unused pnpm workspace metadata remains
Release version is derived dynamically

tasks.title: Enforce dynamic version, tag, changelog and dist invariants
acceptance_criteria: Release audit derives package version
Tag equals v<package.version> when tagged
Changelog has matching release heading before publish
Tracked dist remains reproducible from source

tasks.title: Strengthen layer and public-export consistency checks
acceptance_criteria: Every public export maps to one source owner and one dist artifact
Aliases and barrel re-exports are included in dependency analysis
Duplicate or orphan component ownership blocks CI

tasks.title: Add dependency security, license and provenance gate
acceptance_criteria: Lockfile integrity is verified
High or critical dependency findings block release
License inventory is synchronized with notices
No undeclared build-time dependency is used by scripts

tasks.title: Make browser QA release-complete and evidence-producing
acceptance_criteria: All production screens and declared states have executable coverage
Desktop, tablet and mobile contracts are verified
Theme, keyboard, reduced motion and forced colors are verified
Failures produce actionable traces, screenshots and exact assertions
